cross_suite_aggregation: Forbidden. No mean speedup, weighted total or score combining these suites with one another or with Radiomics.

execution_gate.plan_review: Main agent must review and approve the exact plan-file SHA256 before algorithm timing.
execution_gate.artifact_binding: Execution also requires a separately reviewed immutable wheel/build/environment binding with mandatory wheel/source/implementation/toolchain/flags/package hashes. No editable install or source-tree fallback.
execution_gate.input_freeze: Prepare deterministic inputs and freeze their byte hashes before measuring. Reference-generated patient features for the separate pathology-model case are a declared input-preparation artifact, not new Golden expected values.
execution_gate.no_changes_after_observation: Do not change inputs, seeds, case grid, solvers, enabled features, tolerances, repeat count or targets after timings. Retain failures; fixes require a separately identified rerun and preserve the original evidence.

environments.native_reference_packages: Not installed: sklearn, scipy, statsmodels, PyRadiomics, SimpleITK, joblib, ov/omicverse, WSIData. Native workers may not import an optional numerical/reference backend.
environments.reference_native_package: Not installed/imported. Frozen pathology specifications and the benchmark sklearn adapter execute independently.
environments.source_verification: Before timing, validate fixture/specification hashes and actual reference package/module/build hashes against the approved binding; a version label alone is insufficient. Record extension/shared-library hashes and paths.

execution.thread_verification: Effective BLAS/OpenMP limits must be one in each worker. Record actual libraries and limits. OS observed concurrency remains a separately measured or explicitly unmeasured field.
execution.memory_metric: Full worker-process lifetime peak resident memory, including imports, input buffers, warmup, timed work and numeric report transport: Windows PeakWorkingSetSize / Linux ru_maxrss*1024. Combine worker-final and coordinator high-water observations by maximum. No tracemalloc substitution.
execution.memory_enforcement: Monitor only the owned worker; terminate on budget/timeout failure and retain the observation. Check kernel lifetime peak after completion as well.
execution.worker_lifecycle: Fresh backend interpreter per observation. Warm: imports and fixed input decode, one complete warmup to a fresh output, explicit cleanup, then one timed complete workflow. Cold: no warmup; process launch through completion of imports/input decode/public calls/declared exports/numeric report transport.
execution.non_timed_audits: Package/source/input hashing, wheel checks, comparison-file generation, output-file rehashing, Golden/oracle validation and summary/provenance assembly occur outside the measured worker envelope. Do not burden cold native startup with hashing a larger native binary.
execution.pair_order: Even pair: Python then Rust; odd pair: Rust then Python. Retain all seven pairs, including failures.
execution.file_cache: Uncontrolled OS page cache. Cold means fresh interpreter, not flushed disk cache. These workflows expose no content-cache hit case and may not be labeled cached.
execution.outputs: Fresh directory for every warmup and measured workflow. Replacement is forbidden. Retain output byte counts/hashes and partial artifacts on failure.
execution.failure_policy: Retain execution, warmup, memory, protocol, audit and comparison failures, with source/case identity and diagnostics. A failure cannot disappear through an exception in the coordinator. Failed correctness suppresses speed claims; slow correct results do not become algorithm errors.

learning.dataset: The complete corresponding model_inputs.json dataset, not a favorable subset: 66 patients, two lesions each, 132 rows, four ordered numerical features.
learning.split_plan: Use the corresponding frozen workflow_plans.json verbatim, including all actual outer/inner patient sets and class order; no new random split.

classification.multi_class: ovr for binary; multinomial for multiclass

metrics.CI_scope: ci_method=None for all tasks. This benchmark makes no bootstrap or DeLong interval runtime claim; their correctness/performance is independently scoped.
metrics.classification: Patient-level probabilities: full applicable native point-metric report, confusion/per-class and macro/micro/weighted summaries; matched public sklearn/SciPy definitions. External_A stays prediction_only.
regression: other returned deterministic point fields where matched
metrics.fold_aggregation: Equal mean of patient-scored fold metrics. No pooled-OOF or patient-count-weighted replacement.

measured_graph: train-only nested preprocessing/selection/tuning and final fit
save typed .rad plus training/OOF/CV tables or reference joblib plus corresponding audit/tables
predict all declared cohorts with no outcome column supplied to prediction
patient-level evaluation with separate identified truth
learning.reference_adapter: A benchmark-only public sklearn composition follows frozen golden_workflow preprocessing/fit/tune/score conventions. It does not invoke golden_workflow.main(), generate reference fixtures, refit perturbation oracles, or calculate unnecessary numerical oracle states in the timed call. Frozen workflow-reference comparisons and independent gradient/KKT/leakage checks belong to untimed preflight. Preserve ordinary estimator convergence warnings/errors and the runtime audit/persistence work actually exported.
exports: model.rad or trusted locally generated model.joblib
learning.cross_process_persistence: Check loading the saved artifact in another process during untimed deployment preflight. Measured workflow includes in-worker save/load; do not imply its latency is a separate-process deployment measurement.

clinical_secondary_case.independence_scope: This frozen mathematical fixture has repeated lesions. Explicit sample-unit benchmarking is not a clinical claim of 96 independent patients.

baseline.missing_target_policy: Explicitly omit and report the one missing-target row for observed baseline only; keep per-variable missing counts

logistic.reference_estimator: statsmodels Logit with complete cases, ordinary convergence check, coefficient/covariance/OR/Wald CI outputs

clinical_secondary_case.diagnostic_asymmetry: Native strict LP/rank/numerical certification is real API cost and retained. Do not inject a separate HiGHS/Golden oracle solve into the reference solely to slow it. Report this secondary case independently, never as the full three-task learning result.

pathology.scope: Complete configured pathology front end: decoded/RGB8 PNG input, tiling, QC, full declared color descriptors, strict tile-ID alignment, tile→slide→patient aggregation, genuine tile-feature overlays and exports. These primary rows exclude model training and must never be described as whole pathology-modeling scene latency.
pathology.reference: Frozen independent pathology_spec.py and pathology_aggregate_spec.py. PNG read uses public Pillow RGB mode without unrequested conversion. This is a small reviewable Python specification, not an optimized WSI/pathology engine or a claim against QuPath/PyVips.

generator.source: binary model_inputs.json patients P000 through P011, both lesion rows; selection fixed by patient numeric index, not outcomes or observed speed
generator.normal_image_formula: For the frozen lesion vector v, base=[120+15*clip(v0,-2,2),40+5*clip(v1,-2,2),160+10*clip(v2,-2,2)]. RGB[y,x,c]=uint8(clip(base[c]+((x+2*y) mod 17),0,255)). Use separate IEEE-f64 multiply/add operations then truncation after clipping. No outcome/cohort values enter image generation.
generator.storage: Store original contiguous RGB8 .npy arrays and lossless RGB PNG with Pillow10.4.0 before measurement; freeze every file hash. Decoded case loads arrays before warm timing; PNG case reads the PNG within its workflow.
generator.source_identifier: benchmark-v2:pathology:<patient_id>:<slide_id>, identical logical provenance for decoded and PNG backends; no absolute-path-dependent ID differences
generator.license: CC0-1.0 original synthetic derived input, no patient images

pathology.coordinates: Level-0 pixel edges, x right/y down. y-major then x-minor patch order. x0/y0/width0/height0 distinct from patch size; last x=120 has valid width8, last y=72 has valid height24. Padding never enters QC/color/area denominators. MPP is absent, so only pixel units are emitted.

tile_id.bytes: UTF8 domain radiomics-pixel-tile-v1; for patient_id,slide_id,source append little-endian u64 byte length then UTF8 bytes; then origin0 and pixel_size0 as four little-endian f64 bit patterns; then x,y,patch_width,patch_height as little-endian u64. This is an explicit coordinate/source identity specification, not row-count association.
tile_id.alignment_challenge: Keep geometry rows in y/x generation order, reverse feature rows together with their tile IDs before native/spec alignment. Require exact ID-set match and exact restored row/parent/coordinate order.

pathology.QC: Use pathology_inputs.json qc_config verbatim, retaining all raw scores, tissue masks and exclusion reasons. Normal images are deliberately bounded chromatic midtones; the extra white slide is the explicit all-excluded case.

colors.configuration: Use pathology_inputs.json fixed_edges verbatim; sRGB/D65 as frozen spec
colors.compute_on: All valid nonpadding pixels of accepted tiles; excluded tiles keep QC but colors=null
colors.histograms: Fixed edge/count/probability order; exact counts and denominators
colors.undefined: Preserve null/NaN/Inf state explicitly; never replace with a valid zero
colors.excluded_matrix_rows: All five cells missing: finite canonical zero plus missing=true, never all-zero valid features. Geometry/QC rows and slide→patient mapping remain.
colors.hue_aggregation: Only resultant length enters generic matrices. No arithmetic averaging of raw mean_degrees.

aggregation.feature_order: For each of the five tile matrix columns, the six slide statistics in the declared order; each gets patient_mean after slide-level summary
aggregation.empty: QC-empty retains its slide/patient rows with no_accepted status and missing feature flags. It is explicitly excluded only from the separate outcome-bearing model cohort.

overlays.score: Actual tile rgb_R_mean feature, not a probability or a broadcast patient score
overlays.overlap: Arithmetic mean of actual accepted tile scores; exact u64 coverage at original global pixel centers in half-open valid rectangles
overlays.whole_block_check: Untimed correctness preflight reconstructs whole arrays from exported blocks and compares to one independent whole-canvas spec call. During timing call raster_blocks exactly once per slide; do not time an extra whole-image oracle or duplicate raster calculation.

exports: 24 NPZ overlay blocks with values/coverage/missing/alpha and original global canvas manifests

pathology_patient_model_case.scope: Separate complete learning workflow on one frozen, identical patient-feature input for both backends. It is linked to pathology front-end outputs but its duration is not hidden inside the front-end score.
pathology_patient_model_case.input_freeze: After plan approval and before any timings, one untimed correctness/preparation pass using the frozen independent pathology spec creates/hash-freezes the common 12-patient RGB aggregate matrix. Validate native front-end agreement separately; no native result is rerecorded as Golden.
pathology_patient_model_case.cohorts: P000..P007 train; P008..P009 test; P010..P011 external_pathology with outcomes withheld. QC-empty remains exported but has no outcome and is explicitly absent from this model case.

split_formula.inner_validation_inside_outer: (patient_index//4)%2 == inner_fold within that outer training population
split_formula.final_inner_validation: (patient_index//2)%2 == fold within the eight training patients

pathology_patient_model_case.model_configuration: Same binary LR objectives, lambda order [.05,.1], preprocessing/selection, convergence and saved threshold0.5 as primary learning cases; no CI/bootstrap runtime measurement.

pathology_full_scene_diagnostic.role: Additional whole-scene diagnostic, not a replacement for front-end or MLStats rows, and never a cross-suite aggregate score.
pathology_full_scene_diagnostic.graph: PNG front end on all25slides/600tiles, then fit/persist/load/predict/evaluate the 12 real synthetic patients using that run's own aggregate features and the fixed pathology patient plan; export all outputs.
pathology_full_scene_diagnostic.instrumentation: Client-side stage clocks cover public calls and ordinary exports. The result.save() public method combines model persistence with builtin training/OOF/CV CSV exports, so name that combined stage honestly rather than invent internal timings. No nested stage time is added twice. Record total elapsed plus unassigned boundary overhead.
pathology_full_scene_diagnostic.interpretation: Always show the pixel, aggregation, overlay/export, modeling and prediction stages separately. A fast model must not hide a slow pathology front end. No standalone frontend runtime is described as containing training.

exact: candidate choices and retained feature identities
correctness.nonfinite: Exact null/NaN/Inf/-Inf location and meaning; comparison failure cannot be hidden by selecting only finite cells.
correctness.oracle_boundary: Frozen-Golden comparisons, KKT/gradient leakage oracles, whole/block oracle reconstruction and artifact hashing are outside performance timing. No fixture generation, expected-value update or duplicate oracle fit is included in the reference runtime.
correctness.performance_validity: Only correct matching completed observations receive comparative speed claims. Keep invalid timings as diagnostics and retain all seven declared pairs.

reporting.target_role: Engineering performance targets per valid case/state, not industry standards or algorithm-correctness release gates. Disclose and analyze misses; no per-suite average can hide an individual failure.
reporting.raw: Every warmup and measured attempt, exact input/config/source/binary/package identities, process wall/API/stage times, memory metric and poll granularity, output bytes/digests and comparison status.
reporting.provenance: CPU physical/logical cores, RAM, OS, storage, power mode, background-load status, Python/library/C-extension builds, Rust target/compiler/release/LTO/codegen flags and implementation/source hashes. Explicitly mark unmeasured fields.
limits: Small synthetic data, not clinical validation
Frozen simple Python pathology spec is not an optimized competitor
Predictive evaluation CI=None: no bootstrap or DeLong-interval runtime claim; ordinary Wald OR intervals are included only in the explicitly separate clinical case
Cold interpreter is not cold disk cache
No Radiomics result or cross-suite combined score
